index=g1-robot-data sourcetype IN ("robot:vitals","robot:health") | eval soc='battery.soc', hz='topic_hz.lowstate' | stats latest(soc) as soc, latest(hz) as hz | eval g1_cls=case(isnull(soc),"nd", soc<35,"down", soc<60,"warn", 1==1,"up"), g1_txt=if(isnull(soc),"sin datos", tostring(round(soc,0))."% batería"), dds_cls=case(isnull(hz),"nd", hz<=0.1,"down", 1==1,"up"), dds_txt=if(isnull(hz),"DDS sin datos", "DDS ".tostring(round(hz,0))." Hz"), dds_dur=if(isnull(hz),"3.2", tostring(round(3.2-(min(hz,100)/100)*2.5,2))) | fields g1_cls g1_txt dds_cls dds_txt dds_dur

index=wlc9800 sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry host="$curwb_host$" | dedup host | eval age=now()-_time | spath path=rx_stats{}.rssi_dbm output=rssi | spath path=tx_stats{}.sent_packets output=sent | spath path=tx_stats{}.retries output=retr | spath path=aggr_traffic{}.available_capacity output=cap | spath path=aggr_traffic{}.rx_wlan_kbps output=rxk | spath path=aggr_traffic{}.tx_wlan_kbps output=txk | stats avg(rssi) as rssi, sum(sent) as sent, sum(retr) as retr, min(cap) as cap, sum(rxk) as rxk, sum(txk) as txk, min(age) as age, dc(host) as nodos | eval retry=if(sent>0, 100*retr/sent, null()), mb=(coalesce(rxk,0)+coalesce(txk,0))/1000 | eval air_cls=case(nodos==0 OR isnull(age),"nd", age>120,"down", rssi<-75 OR retry>15,"warn", 1==1,"up"), air_txt=case(nodos==0 OR isnull(age),"sin telemetría", age>120,"sin telemetría hace ".tostring(round(age/60,0))." min", 1==1,"RSSI ".tostring(round(rssi,0))." dBm · retry ".tostring(round(retry,1))."%"), air_cap=if(isnull(cap),"capacidad —", "capacidad ".tostring(round(cap/1000,0))." Mbps · en uso ".tostring(round(mb,1))." Mbps · ".tostring(nodos)." radios"), air_dur=tostring(round(3.2-(min(mb,50)/50)*2.5,2)) | fields air_cls air_txt air_cap air_dur

| mstats avg(network.loss) as loss, avg(network.latency) as lat, avg(network.jitter) as jit WHERE index=thousandeyes by "thousandeyes.source.agent.name", "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.source.agent.name" as agente, "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where agente="$te_agent$" AND (test="$te_test$" OR test="$te_test_splk$" OR test="$te_test_app$") | eval k=case(test="$te_test$","te", test="$te_test_splk$","splk", true(),"app") | stats avg(loss) as loss, avg(lat) as lat, avg(jit) as jit by k | eval cls=case(isnull(loss),"nd", loss>=100,"down", loss>5 OR lat>0.15,"warn", 1==1,"up"), rt=if(isnull(lat),"RTT —","RTT ".tostring(round(lat*1000,0))." ms"), tt=if(isnull(loss),"TE sin datos","TE ".tostring(round(lat*1000,0))." ms · ".tostring(round(loss,1))."% pérdida · ".tostring(round(jit,1))." ms jitter") | stats values(eval(if(k=="te",cls,null()))) as te_cls, values(eval(if(k=="te",tt,null()))) as te_txt, values(eval(if(k=="splk",cls,null()))) as splk_cls, values(eval(if(k=="splk",rt,null()))) as splk_rtt, values(eval(if(k=="app",cls,null()))) as app_cls, values(eval(if(k=="app",rt,null()))) as app_rtt | fillnull value="nd" te_cls splk_cls app_cls | fillnull value="TE sin datos" te_txt | fillnull value="RTT —" splk_rtt app_rtt

div.div: Agente g1-jetson-01 en PC2, tests sintéticos y estado del agente · index=thousandeyes, thousandeyes_alerts

search.query: | mstats avg(network.loss) as v WHERE index=thousandeyes by "thousandeyes.source.agent.name", "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.source.agent.name" as agente, "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where agente="$te_agent$" AND test="$te_test$" | stats avg(v) as v | eval v=round(v,2)

| mstats avg(network.latency) as v WHERE index=thousandeyes by "thousandeyes.source.agent.name", "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.source.agent.name" as agente, "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where agente="$te_agent$" AND test="$te_test$" | stats avg(v) as v | eval v=round(v*1000,1)

| mstats avg(network.jitter) as v WHERE index=thousandeyes by "thousandeyes.source.agent.name", "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.source.agent.name" as agente, "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where agente="$te_agent$" AND test="$te_test$" | stats avg(v) as v | eval v=round(v,1)
index=thousandeyes_alerts sourcetype=thousandeyes:agent agent_name="$te_agent$" | stats latest(agent_state) as estado | eval Estado=upper(coalesce(estado,"no enrolado")) | fields Estado

panel.title: Enlace del robot en el tiempo — $te_agent$

search.query: | mstats avg(network.loss) as loss, avg(network.latency) as lat_s, avg(network.jitter) as jitter WHERE index=thousandeyes span=5m by "thousandeyes.source.agent.name", "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.source.agent.name" as agente, "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where agente="$te_agent$" AND test="$te_test$" | eval "Pérdida (%)"=round(loss,2), "Latencia (ms)"=round(lat_s*1000,1), "Jitter (ms)"=round(jitter,2) | fields _time "Pérdida (%)" "Latencia (ms)" "Jitter (ms)"

index=thousandeyes_alerts sourcetype=thousandeyes:agent agent_name="$te_agent$" | stats latest(agent_state) as Estado, latest(last_seen) as "Último contacto", latest(public_ip) as "IP pública", latest(network) as "Red / ISP", latest(location) as Ubicación, latest(ip_addresses) as "IP interna", latest(agent_type) as Tipo | transpose column_name=Campo | rename "row 1" as Valor

| mstats avg(network.loss) as loss, avg(network.latency) as lat, avg(network.jitter) as jit, count(network.loss) as n WHERE index=thousandeyes span=5m by "thousandeyes.test.name", "thousandeyes.source.agent.name", "thousandeyes.test.type" | rename "thousandeyes.test.name" as Test, "thousandeyes.source.agent.name" as Agente, "thousandeyes.test.type" as Tipo | where like(Test, "$te_tag$ - %") | stats sum(n) as Muestras, avg(loss) as loss, avg(lat) as lat, avg(jit) as jit, max(_time) as ultima by Test, Agente, Tipo | eval "Pérdida (%)"=round(loss,2), "Latencia (ms)"=round(lat*1000,1), "Jitter (ms)"=round(jit,2), "Última muestra"=strftime(ultima,"%F %H:%M") | table Test Agente Tipo Muestras "Pérdida (%)" "Latencia (ms)" "Jitter (ms)" "Última muestra" | sort Test

| mstats avg(network.loss) as loss WHERE index=thousandeyes span=5m by "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where like(test, "$te_tag$ - %") | timechart span=5m avg(loss) as "Pérdida (%)" by test

| mstats avg(network.latency) as lat WHERE index=thousandeyes span=5m by "thousandeyes.test.name" | rename "thousandeyes.test.name" as test | where like(test, "$te_tag$ - %") | eval lat_ms=lat*1000 | timechart span=5m avg(lat_ms) as "Latencia (ms)" by test

div.h2: 3 · CURWB — el enlace inalámbrico del G1
div.div: Mesh Point a bordo ⇢ Mesh End cableado · index=wlc9800 sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry · filtrado por $curwb_host$ (hoy: todos los nodos)

search.query: index=wlc9800 sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry host="$curwb_host$" | dedup host | spath path=rx_stats{}.rssi_dbm output=rssi | stats avg(rssi) as v | eval v=round(v,0)

index=wlc9800 sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry host="$curwb_host$" | dedup host | spath path=tx_stats{}.sent_packets output=sent | spath path=tx_stats{}.retries output=retr | stats sum(sent) as s, sum(retr) as r | eval v=if(s>0, round(100*r/s,2), null()) | fields v
index=wlc9800 sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry host="$curwb_host$" | dedup host | spath path=rx_stats{}.mcs output=mcs | stats avg(mcs) as v | eval v=round(v,1)
index=wlc9800 sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry host="$curwb_host$" | dedup host | spath path=aggr_traffic{}.available_capacity output=cap | stats min(cap) as v | eval v=round(v/1000,0)
index=wlc9800 sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry host="$curwb_host$" | head 1 | eval v=round(now()-_time,0) | fields v

index=wlc9800 sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry host="$curwb_host$" | spath path=rx_stats{} output=rx | mvexpand rx | spath input=rx | eval enlace=src_ip." -> ".dst_ip | timechart span=1m avg(rssi_dbm) as RSSI by enlace limit=20

index=wlc9800 sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry host="$curwb_host$" | spath path=tx_stats{} output=tx | mvexpand tx | spath input=tx | eval enlace=src_ip." -> ".dst_ip | eval retry_pct=if(sent_packets>0,(retries/sent_packets)*100,0) | timechart span=1m avg(retry_pct) as "Retry (%)" by enlace limit=20

index=wlc9800 sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry host="$curwb_host$" | spath path=aggr_traffic{} output=traffic | mvexpand traffic | spath input=traffic | timechart span=1m avg(eval(rx_wlan_kbps/1000)) as "RX (Mbps)", avg(eval(tx_wlan_kbps/1000)) as "TX (Mbps)", avg(eval(available_capacity/1000)) as "Capacidad (Mbps)"

index=wlc9800 sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry host="$curwb_host$" | dedup host | spath path=rx_stats{} output=rx | mvexpand rx | spath input=rx | eval Enlace=src_ip." -> ".dst_ip, "Edad (s)"=round(now()-_time,0) | table host Enlace rssi_dbm mcs nss channel_width_mhz rate_type age_ms "Edad (s)" | rename host as Nodo, rssi_dbm as "RSSI (dBm)", mcs as MCS, nss as NSS, channel_width_mhz as "Ancho (MHz)", rate_type as PHY, age_ms as "Age (ms)"
